definition: προσ-λαμβάνω  [in LXX: Psa.18:16 (מָשָׁה hi.), Psa.73:24 (לָקַח), etc. ;] __1. to take in addition.  __2. to take to oneself, take, receive; in NT always mid., -ομαι;  __(a) of things: of food, with accusative, Act.27:33; with genitive part., Act.27:36;  __(b) of persons: with accusative, Mat.16:22, Mrk.8:32 (see Swete, in l), Act.17:5 18:26 28:2, Rom.14:1, 3 15:7, Phm 17.† (AS)
